note: A function with a local variable. Covers hif-backend#83, fixed by hif-backend 030f9d1: hif2verilog used to emit the local as a declaration assignment inside the function body, which is only legal at module level, so the regenerated file did not reparse. The local now comes out as a plain `reg [4:0] wide;` declaration with the assignment in the body. user_function.v covers the function path without a local; this design is the local, which that one was reshaped to avoid.
